newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain intermediaries Q1 pre-tax profit up 98.2%.
newsitem.headline: Spain intermediaries Q1 pre-tax profit up 98.2%.

text.p: Spanish financial intermediaries had first-quarter total pre-tax profits of 17.59 billion pesetas, up 98.2 percent versus the same period a year-ago, the stock market commission CNMV said on Friday.
Financial intermediaries, which are members of the bourse, made 14.26 million pesetas pre-tax profit versus 6.33 million the the first quarter 1996.

Of this, profit from capital and trading gains was 66.62 billion pesetas from 29.79 billion in the first three months of 1996, while total fees on third party orders rose to 14.36 billion pesetas from 9.29 billion.
